errors.evidence: The Y-axis does not have a label. It only has tick mark labels indicating percentage values.

errors.text_span: достига най-високата си стойност от 3,25% през 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The line reaches its highest value in 2017, not 2014. The peak value is approximately 2.9%, not 3.25%. The value in 2014 is only about 0.7%.
The value in 2015 is approximately 0.2%. The value of 0.1% is reached in 2016.

errors.text_span: Линията се запазва на 0,0% от 2016 г. до 2017 г.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The value in 2016 is at its minimum of approximately 0.1%, and in 2017 it rises sharply to its peak of approximately 2.9%. The value is 0.0% in 2013, not during 2016-2017.
The line decreases from 2017 to 2018, it does not increase ('покачва'). The value in 2018 is approximately 2.6%, not 2.15%.

errors.text_span: Накрая линията намалява до 2,45% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The line slightly increases from 2018 to 2019, it does not decrease ('намалява'). The value in 2019 is approximately 2.7%, not 2.45%.
